description: Undo a booking: take the visits off a job and clear its schedule, returning it to needs scheduling. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. This does not itself email or text the customer. Housecall Pro still sends its own reminders as the date approaches, and that depends on your account's settings. The job record remains, with its customer, line items and notes - this undoes the scheduling, not the job. Housecall Pro's API has no route that deletes a job, so a job created by mistake is closed out in Housecall Pro itself.

appointment_ids.description: The visits to remove (appt_...). Omit to remove every visit currently on the job, which is read first.

name: hcp_unschedule_job
